LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.0.label: Astral Inheritance
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.0.descript: Retains original health, mitigation and per-hit damage cap. Later injury triggers require actual enemy damage; fully absorbed hits do not count. Progression stays with the item.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.1.label: Crossfire Recovery
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.1.descript: Take actual damage from two different enemies consecutively, no more than 4 seconds apart, to heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Repeated hits from the same attacker neither count nor extend the timer. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.2.label: Fixed-star Reprisal
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.2.descript: Taking actual enemy damage marks that attacker for 4 seconds, once per 8 seconds, with one mark maximum. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.3.label: Reformed Bulwark
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.3.descript: After Crossfire Recovery actually heals you, gain 50 base shield points for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. No recoverable injury means no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.4.label: Gathered Resolve
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.4.descript: After Crossfire Recovery actually heals you, store one reprisal for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. A later ordinary hit consumes it for 75 bonus damage. Store at most one. Base rewards: damage 75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.5.label: Falling Shards
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.5.descript: After Fixed-star Reprisal deals actual bonus damage, deal 25 damage to one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Never hits the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.6.label: Shelter Beneath Stars
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Starward.nodes.6.descript: After Fixed-star Reprisal deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Never heals you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.
